categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server event handling in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes a flaw in HTTP read-side throttling that prematurely reopened the TCP receive window, causing intermittent CI test failures in interface_http.py (#36216). As noted in the description, the scope is limited ('worst-case scenario for this bug is only 65kB so this is not a critical OOM fix'), making it a worthwhile stability fix rather than a critical vulnerability.
